title: Dua e Faraj - Ilahi Azomal Bala
categoryChain: Dua e Faraj - Ilahi Azomal Bala
introduction:
DUA E FARAJ - DUA SAHIB AL AMR (A.T.F.S.)

The Supplication of the Patron of the Matter; i.e. Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.):

In his book of al-Balad al-Amin, Shaykh al-Kaf’ami has mentioned that Imam al-Mahdi(a.s.) taught this supplicatory prayer to a prisoner who was then set free:

verses.translation: O my God, ordeal has become immeasurable.
The hidden has become exposed.
The covered has been disclosed.
Hope has been cut off.
The earth has become narrow (despite its vastness).
The sky has. been prevented (from giving its blessings),
(among all that) Your help is only sought,
to You is the complaint,

verses.arabic: وَ عَلَيْكَ الْمُعَوَّلُ فِيْ الشِّدَّةِ وَ الرَّخَاۤءِ
verses.translation: and upon You is the reliance in hardships and leisure.

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلٰى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ اٰلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
verses.translation: O Allah, (please do) Send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

verses.arabic: اُوْلِيْ الْاَمْرِ الَّذِيْنَ فَرَضْتَ عَلَيْنَا طَاعَتَهُمْ
verses.translation: the men in authority the obedience to whom has been made obligatory upon us by You
and whose (special) rank has been made known for us by You;
so, (please do) relieve our ordeals in the name of them,
a relief that is as immediate and forthcoming
as the twinkling of an eye or even closer.
O Muhammad! O 'Ali!
O 'Ali! O Muhammad!
(please do) save me, for you both do save,
and support me, for you both do support.
O our master, the Patron of the Age,
(I beseech you for) relief! (I beseech you for) relief! (I beseech you for) relief!
(Please do) aid me! (Please do) aid me! (Please do) aid me!
This hour! This hour! This hour!
Immediately! Immediately! Immediately!
O (Allah the) most Merciful of all those who show mercy,
in the name of Muhammad and his Immaculate Household (respond).
